title: Answer
description: The PRD §5 output block plus machine-scoreable fields. `ats.contracts.format_answer_text` renders this object into the exact §5 text format and field order; this schema governs the underlying data, not the rendered text order.

question_id.description: Matches the question_id from the input question_set.

answer.description: PRD §5 'Answer' field. 'N/A' if genuinely not answerable.

evidence.description: PRD §5 'Evidence' block, as human-readable text matching the required output format.

timestamps.description: Time range(s) as text, e.g. '905 to 1420, 2110 to 2295 (seconds from start)', or 'N/A'.

explanation.description: PRD §5 'Explanation' field, reasoning grounded in the observed signal. 'N/A' only permitted at Task 1.

tier_inferred.description: Which of the four PRD task tiers this question was routed to (machine field, not part of the rendered §5 text).

cited_intervals.description: Machine-readable form of the cited evidence, for automatic IoU/grounding scoring. Empty only when evidence is legitimately N/A (Task 1).

modality.description: Machine-readable counterpart of evidence.sensor_modality, used by the scoring harness.

channels.description: Machine-readable counterpart of evidence.sensor_channels, e.g. ['acc_x','acc_y','acc_z'] or ['all'] or ['N/A'].
